name: remote_service_slow
title: The far end is slow
description: DNS, the router and the path are all healthy. Only the service being contacted is slow, so the answer is that nothing is wrong with your network.

card.summary: Your router and the path out to the internet both look normal, but the services we test are taking 81 ms to send their first byte, about 62 ms more than the network itself explains.
remediation: Check whether other sites are fine; if they are, the problem is at the far end and not with your connection.
